Reproduce the SCAD/MCP paper

Source: vignettes/articles/reproduce-paper.Rmd
reproduce-paper.Rmd

The accompanying manuscript is Nonconvex Geographically Weighted Regression for Local Variable Selection. Its independent reproduction bundle contains the simulation and ACS application scripts, public Census input snapshot, historical package source archives, configuration, seeds and SHA-256 manifest.

Download the materials

  • Independent reproduction ZIP
  • Current package source, including ACS data
  • Installation and run guide
  • Executed validation and limits
  • Source provenance

Repository downloads require repository access. The independently supplied ZIP can also be used without a GitHub checkout.

Check before a full run

After extracting the reproduction ZIP, open a terminal in its scad-mcp directory. With the required R/Python toolchains and declared dependencies available, the launcher provides setup and source checks:

python3 reproduce.py simulation setup
python3 reproduce.py real-data setup
python3 reproduce.py simulation check
python3 reproduce.py real-data check

Follow the standalone guide for preflight, small smoke tests, full execution, progress, checkpoint/resume, verification and reporting. A completion marker or progress percentage alone is insufficient: the verification command checks task completeness, scientific signatures and output integrity.

Software versions and validation

The current package is 0.4.0.9013. The paper’s simulation used 0.4.0 and its county analysis used 0.4.0.9006. The launcher installs those historical sources into separate project libraries. Retain them to reproduce the reported analyses.

The distribution validation records a local package check with Status: OK and 1,203 passing testthat expectations, together with small interrupted and resumed study workflows. These are recorded checks for the distributed sources, not a claim of continuous-integration coverage on every platform. No full study was rerun for the documentation preview.

Cite the software and data 

citation("gwrs")

The package citation identifies the software and accompanying manuscript. The manuscript remains an unpublished work until a publication record exists. Please also acknowledge the Census Bureau when using the prepared ACS table.
